title: skill.care.initiate_return timeout — effect-unknown reconciliation
risk: A hanging dependency is interpreted as success or retried blind, producing phantom business effects for skill.care.initiate_return.

steps.action: Arm the adapter to accept then hang
steps.expected: ReverseLogisticsConnector accepts the request and never responds; the engine deadline is 3500 ms

steps.action: Observe the abort and the failure classification
steps.expected: provider accepts the RMA then the response is lost past 3500ms -> EFFECT_UNKNOWN, execution_status='failed', OUTCOME unknown; the reservation stays RESERVED and reconciliation by effect_key finds the existing RMA; no second return authorisation and no second label

steps.action: Reconcile the unconfirmed effect by effect_key

no success execution_status and no receipt exists without provider evidence; the customer-visible state is derived from the receipt, not the request
